sources.snippet: Text Generation model with 2B parameters, built with Transformers. Download, explore files and run it on Hugging Face.

sources.title: Qwen3-1.7B - VRAM Requirements, Specs & Benchmarks
sources.snippet: About Qwen3-1.7B Qwen3-1.7B is a high-efficiency dense foundation model from Alibaba Cloud supporting both Thinking and Non-Thinking modes for edge and mobile deployments. It provides low-latency conversational responses and step-by-step logic over an extensible 131K context.
